scope: Development-side coverage view over reviewed hypotheses and published implementation-contract mappings only; not a case registry, runtime resource, manifest, provider input, training dataset, or hosted authorization.

hypothesis_coverage.blocking_boundary: The exact fail-closed Q01--Q04 chain is represented, but no reusable Harness/runtime selector contract is implemented.
hypothesis_coverage.next_route_implication: A later route may reuse this exact chain as reviewed contract provenance, but it must not upgrade the hypothesis to runtime or hosted eligibility.

hypothesis_coverage.blocking_boundary: The reviewed Q01/Q02 observable/operation pair is mapped, but the project has no reusable Harness/runtime observation contract and this hypothesis declares no Q03/Q04 repair route.
hypothesis_coverage.next_route_implication: A later route may use this exact declared-stage mapping as development-side provenance, but it must not treat the hypothesis as runtime or hosted eligible.

hypothesis_coverage.blocking_boundary: Reviewed execution evidence exists, but no source-linked implementation-contract mapping currently states how the bounded rollback chain should be represented.
hypothesis_coverage.next_route_implication: This remains a reviewed development-side boundary only until a later bounded contract-mapping package is explicitly selected.

hypothesis_coverage.blocking_boundary: Reviewed family-scoped operation units and evidence exist, but no source-linked implementation-contract mapping currently records exact Q01--Q04 representation for this grouped hypothesis.
hypothesis_coverage.next_route_implication: Later routes must isolate one bounded grammar hypothesis and publish its exact contract mapping before citing implementation coverage.

hypothesis_coverage.blocking_boundary: The reviewed external-history material is a boundary pattern, and no source-linked implementation-contract mapping is published for it.
hypothesis_coverage.next_route_implication: This hypothesis remains an explicit limitation boundary rather than a candidate implementation-coverage claim.

status_definitions.implemented: A published source-linked mapping shows the hypothesis's exact declared-stage contract and records it as implemented.
status_definitions.contract_only: A published source-linked mapping shows the hypothesis's exact declared-stage contract, but the project still lacks the reusable Harness/runtime contract needed for an implementation claim.
status_definitions.unsupported: A published source-linked mapping records an exact declared-stage boundary as unsupported rather than implemented.
status_definitions.missing_link: No published source-linked implementation-contract mapping currently records the hypothesis's exact implementation-contract representation.

maintenance.drift_disposition: A missing hypothesis, stale hash, unknown mapping ID, stage mismatch, or widened status is documentation drift. Repair the reviewed source-linked mapping; do not infer implementation from raw evidence or runtime material.
maintenance.migration_boundary: M154 adds a development-side coverage view only. It does not alter the M146 crosswalk, M150 case-evidence mapping, M152 implementation-contract mapping, case metadata, manifests, runtime resources, or provider policy.
